diet: Apples, one bite at a time
bio: An apple seed with a green sprout and one bite already missing. It insists the bite was a design choice.
A turtle with a black ring of shell round its neck. It presents one more thing, then one more thing after that.
Its violet shell bends the air; everything near it looks a little better than it is. People queue overnight to stand close.
note: Simple on the outside, and only on the outside.
The field around it is a feature.
